caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two doors, one of which is fully open and the other is partially open. The cabinet is a light to medium brown color, showing natural wood grain and paneling details on the doors. Inside, there are three interior shelves dividing the space into four main horizontal compartments, with the bottom compartment being larger due to the base of the cabinet. The cabinet has a simple, rectangular construction with crown molding along the top edge. The hinges and keyholes are visible on the doors. The background is plain and light-colored, giving contrast to the wooden cabinet which is centered in the composition. The text "Rose Krier" appears beneath the cabinet near the bottom left.
title: Triangular Corner Safe
